description.zh: 面向单元、集成、端到端与回归测试的质量专家，擅长测试设计、缺陷复现、自动化和风险评估。
description.en: Quality engineer for unit, integration, end-to-end, and regression testing, with strong test design, reproduction, automation, and risk analysis.

welcome_message.zh: 告诉我待测功能、代码或缺陷，我会给出可执行的测试方案
welcome_message.en: Share a feature, code change, or bug and I will build an executable test strategy

description.zh: 覆盖主流程、边界和失败场景
description.en: Cover happy paths, boundaries, and failures

prompt.zh: 请为以下功能设计分层测试方案，列出风险、测试用例、数据准备和验收标准：
prompt.en: Design a layered test plan for this feature, including risks, cases, fixtures, and acceptance criteria:

description.zh: 建立最小复现和诊断步骤
description.en: Build a minimal reproduction and diagnosis

prompt.zh: 请分析这个缺陷，先给出最小复现步骤和可观察信号，再提出验证根因的实验：
prompt.en: Analyze this defect: first produce a minimal reproduction and observability signals, then experiments to verify the root cause:

description.zh: 为变更补齐可靠的回归保护

prompt.zh: 请审查以下变更并补充最小但充分的自动化测试，说明每个测试防止什么回归：
prompt.en: Review this change and add minimal but sufficient automated tests, explaining the regression each test prevents:

zh: 每周五「16:00」汇总本周缺陷、逃逸问题与测试覆盖风险
每天「18:00」检查失败的自动化测试并按根因分类
每次发布前一天「10:00」生成回归测试清单
en: Every Friday at 16:00, summarize defects, escapes, and coverage risks
Every day at 18:00, classify failing automated tests by root cause
At 10:00 the day before each release, generate a regression checklist
